emergency.title: Emergency Assistance Directory
emergency.subtitle: Official verified 24/7 toll-free hotlines across India
emergency.critical_banner_desc: Dial 112 immediately for unified Police, Fire, and Ambulance dispatch across India.
emergency.protocol_title: How to Communicate Clearly During an Emergency Call
emergency.protocol_sub: Guidelines to ensure first responders locate and assist you rapidly:
emergency.step1_desc: Mention city, landmark, street name, building number, or GPS pin before describing the situation.
emergency.step2_title: Speak Clearly and Stay on the Line
emergency.step2_desc: Describe the emergency clearly. Do not hang up until the operator tells you it is safe to do so.
emergency.step3_desc: Clearly state if violence, medical injury, fire, or suspicious stalkers are involved.
emergency.step4_desc: Keep battery alive and ensure the operator or dispatch officer can reach you on callback.
emergency.helpline_112_desc: Single unified 24/7 response center for Police, Fire, and Ambulance across India.
emergency.helpline_181_desc: Toll-free 24-hour helpline dedicated to women affected by violence, distress, or harassment.
emergency.helpline_1091_desc: Direct rapid response from dedicated women police units and Singapen Kaval Padai divisions.
emergency.helpline_108_desc: Fast medical emergency response and government hospital ambulance dispatch across India.
emergency.helpline_1098_desc: National 24-hour emergency phone outreach service for children in need of protection.
emergency.helpline_1930_desc: Assistance with cyber harassment, online stalking, morphing, and digital financial fraud.

about.title: About SafeHer
about.subtitle: Women's Safety & Emergency Assistance Platform
about.mission_desc: SafeHer is dedicated to providing every woman with rapid, reliable, and privacy-respecting emergency assistance tools across India.
about.dual_mode_desc: Rehearse and test without false alarms using Test Mode; dispatch high-priority SMS and WhatsApp alerts in Real Emergency Mode.
about.privacy_desc: Zero background location tracking. No audio uploaded to any remote server. 100% on-device AI sound and fall detection.
about.helpline_integration_desc: Unified direct dial links to India's National Emergency Helpline (112) and Women Helpline (181).
about.version_info: Version 2.4 • Built with React, Vite & Capacitor for Android
